_rules.elig: Full-text eligibility: Y, or N with reason.
_rules.cd: O1, detection/classification studies only: Y if the model is evaluated on or applied to continuous records; N if only pre-segmented windows or events are classified; NA if the study has no detection or classification task.
_rules.split: I1: Y if data are partitioned by event, time block, well or site (including one sample per event, with any augmentation applied after the split); N if windows, traces, sensor combinations or augmented samples are split at random, or augmentation precedes the split; NS if not stated; NA if there is no training on field data (synthetic-only training or a pretrained model applied without retraining).
_rules.indep: I2: Y if a held-out test set (or independent test data) is used; N if only cross-validation or training/validation results; NA as for split.
_rules.ext: E1: Y if performance is reported on data from another site, well, mine, sensor type or recording domain; P if only synthetic-to-field or qualitative; N otherwise.
_rules.prev: O2, detection/classification only: Y if the class composition of the evaluation data is stated; N if not; NA if no labelled evaluation.
_rules.fa: O3, detection/classification only: Y if false alarms are reported per unit time; N otherwise.
_rules.lat: O4: Y if latency or throughput is reported together with the hardware; P if only one of the two; N if neither.
_rules.code: A1: Y if code is in a public repository; P if promised; N otherwise.
_rules.data: A2: Y if the data are public (repository or supplement); R if restricted or on request; N if not available or not stated.
_rules.unc: U1: Y if uncertainty or calibration of model outputs is reported; N otherwise.

_coder: Coded by a large language model (Claude Opus 5.5) from full-text passages retrieved by keyword search, 27 September 2026; to be verified by a human reviewer.
